messages:
elaine: Quick note 	6 redoing the quickstart Hello app to make Docker + auth less magical. I drafted a smaller flow that shows: env var, header, and SDK examples. Will push a PR in ~15m.

matt: Great. Can we also make the Docker example avoid root user practice? Last PR used root and support called that out.

elaine: Yep planning a non-root Dockerfile + a .env.example. Also adding a minimal health endpoint example so people can smoke test the container locally.

sophia: I noticed some users copy the curl example into browser tools and hit CORS. Suggest adding a small callout: "don't expose API key in client-side code" plus a server-proxy snippet.

elaine: Good call. I'll add a server-proxy snippet in Node (Express) with env var usage and one-line middleware for Authorization header: 
```js
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  const token = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY;
  req.headers['authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  next();
});
```

matt: Also ensure the curl examples include Content-Type and JSON body. Small nit but saves people time.

elaine: updated in my head :) will include content-type in the examples.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR checklist - include runnable examples under /examples, run linkcheck, and add the 'quickstart-cleanup' label.

elaine: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/811 - includes: cleaned Dockerfile, .env.example, server-proxy snippet, SDK v4 auth example, and a tiny migration note for v3 users.

matt: Quick code review done. Left two comments: 1) add HEALTHCHECK to Dockerfile, 2) mention recommended timeout (20s) for sync calls in Node.

ci-bot: CI started for PR 811 - docs lint, code samples run, linkcheck.

elaine: thanks. I'm adding HEALTHCHECK and calling out the timeout default. Also adding a short troubleshooting section for: invalid_key, rate_limit, and socket_timeout errors.

sophia: I'll run the example on mac + linux and verify Docker healthcheck behavior. If anything flakes I'll report back here.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR 811 (linkcheck: ok, sample-run: ok). Preview available at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/quickstart/hello-docker-auth

elaine: Preview live 	6 smoke testing now: testing curl header, env var flow, and the proxy example.

matt: Smoke-tested header and SDK examples. HEALTHCHECK works. One tiny thing: the README path to the sample app uses a relative link that 404s in the preview.

sophia: Found a small typo in .env.example (MISSING underscore in REDWOOD_API_KEY). I'll open a follow-up PR after this merges.

elaine: Thanks all. Plan: merge once the README link is fixed (I'll push a tiny edit) and then backport the migration note to the v3 migration doc. Target: EOD.

matt: Sounds good. Ping here when merged and I'll forward to onboarding team for the hands-on lab update.

elaine: Will do. :shipit:
